scene: Episode 02 · Scene 08 — EXT. HESSEL PIER — RECIPROCITY HOUSE — THREE SECONDS TO THE WRIST
shot: v2: the compliment is cut off BY A CUT (§66 — v1 completed it); the three seconds stay one unbroken take in their own shot; frost scoped to Pikk only (v1 leaked it onto Tomas's 'nothing' hand); 'It was not intended as a comfort.' restored as the button; Tomas large and on his verified plate; Amina to her sheet.
prompt:
Live-action mythic modernism. Photoreal, tactile, cinematic, anamorphic widescreen, 24fps, shallow depth of field. FIVE SHOTS, cut in camera at the stated times, and no other coverage. All spoken dialogue is in ENGLISH.

REFERENCE PRECEDENCE: @Image1 IS THE ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY for this chamber. @Image2 IS THE AUTHORITY FOR THE STONE ITSELF. @Image3 IS THE AUTHORITY FOR THE SAMPLE PODS: small clear glass-and-ceramic cylinders on thin dark articulated metal armatures.

THE CHAMBER: a small round room of COARSE, COLD, WEATHERED DARK GREY GRANITE, almost charcoal in shadow, salt-stained and pitted, laid in large heavy irregular blocks — NOT pale, NOT cream, NOT limestone. A row of small HORIZONTAL openings, each a hand's width across and only a few centimetres high, is cut into the curved wall at waist height with a thin warm amber light deep inside each one. Directly under them the stone sill is hollowed into a long smooth trough by four hundred years of hands. One stone bench. One plain doorway onto a flat white sky and the frozen pier. NO MACHINERY ANYWHERE.

TWO PRACTICAL LIGHT SOURCES, NEVER BLENDED, NEITHER WITH A VISIBLE FIXTURE: COLD blue-white 6500K daylight through the doorway, and WARM amber 3200K from deep inside the slots. Every face is lit cold on one side and warm on the other. WHICH SIDE OF A FACE IS WARM IS INFORMATION.

THE RULE OF THE SLOT LIGHT, established earlier and used here: when a slot is DRAWING from the hand in it, the amber light inside that slot DIMS for as long as the draw lasts; when a slot is taking NOTHING, its light stays STEADY and unchanged. It is a practical lamp on a dimmer: it never flashes, strobes, pulses or burns brighter.

CAST — FOUR PEOPLE:
@Image4 and @Image5 are PIKK — compact, bald, LONG POINTED EARS, olive-grey skin, a deeply lined middle-aged adult face, soot-grey workwear with flat tan-ochre panels; his ears are OPAQUE and MATTE, never backlit. 
@Image6 is DR. AMINA VEY — a woman in her forties with LIGHT BROWN SKIN and DARK CURLY HAIR in a LOOSE MESSY BUN with strands escaping. Layered SLATE-BLUE technical workwear with a high draped cowl collar, a LEATHER STRAP across the chest, a WIDE OXBLOOD-RUST SASH, heavy laced BOOTS, small CLEAR GLASS-AND-CERAMIC SAMPLE PODS riding on thin dark articulated metal armatures off her harness, and an open field notebook. She is the ONLY person here in blue. She wears NO black column, NO rectangular panels, NO braided crown and NO drop earrings.
@Image7 and @Image8 are TOMAS GREY — a MAN in his thirties, tall, OLIVE-SKINNED, dark CURLY hair and a SHORT DARK BEARD. @Image7 IS THE ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY FOR TOMAS — his face, his collar, his cuffs, his coat and the black ribbon around him — AND IT OVERRIDES EVERY OTHER IMAGE AND EVERY WORD OF DESCRIPTION ON THAT SUBJECT. COPY HIS COSTUME FROM IT EXACTLY: a floor-length BLACK ROBE-COAT with ONE FLAT CREAM-OATMEAL LINEN PANEL down the centre front, TURNED-BACK CREAM CUFFS at both wrists, a TALL SMOOTH CYLINDRICAL CREAM COLLAR wrapped close around his throat with a level top edge — a smooth closed tube, never flared, never a wing, never a scallop, never two upright panels — and THE CLAUSE RIBBON, a long matte black band covered in fine pale engraved script, LOOPING AND SPIRALLING AROUND HIS BODY in large open curves and standing away from him in the air. THERE IS ONLY ONE TOMAS IN THIS FILM.
@Image9 is BEATRICE MORD — a WOMAN in her early forties, dark hair in a TIGHT HIGH TOPKNOT, clean-shaven, in a BLACK ASYMMETRICAL WRAP COAT wrapped and belted across the body over a full-length OXBLOOD-AND-RUST underskirt panel. She has NO cream panel, NO tall collar, NO cuffs, NO ribbon, NO blue, NO rust sash, NO leather chest strap, NO glass cylinders, NO earrings and NO veil.

NOBODY INSIDE THIS CHAMBER PRODUCES VISIBLE BREATH. Out through the doorway on the pier, every waiting person's breath IS visible in white plumes.

THE FROST IN THIS FILM BELONGS TO PIKK'S HAND AND NOTHING ELSE. It appears in SHOTS 3 AND 4 ONLY, on his hand only, growing outward from his knuckles into the air. In SHOT 5 TOMAS'S HAND STAYS PINK AND CLEAN FOR THE WHOLE SHOT.

=== SHOT 1 — 0:00 to 0:05 — MEDIUM, 50mm, LOCKED, LOW AT SILL HEIGHT ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT:
AMINA (plainly, to the room, with the slightly apologetic courtesy of a scientist about to use a colleague as an instrument): "Volunteers."
PIKK (off screen, easy, bored, already walking): "It's a warm hole in a wall, Doctor."

The camera is LOW, its lens level with the hollowed stone trough, so the row of small warm slots sits at our own eye height. CLOSE TO THE LENS AND OUT OF FOCUS AT FRAME LEFT is THE BACK OF PIKK'S HEAD AND SHOULDER — we are standing behind him. In the middle distance at frame right AMINA has clamped her two glass pods on their armatures either side of ONE slot. DEEPEST IN THE SHOT, small, far from the wall and fully in the cold doorway light, stand BEATRICE and TOMAS. After Amina's one word NOBODY MOVES FOR ONE FULL SECOND. Then PIKK'S HEAD AND SHOULDER SIMPLY LEAVE THE FOREGROUND — he walks out of the near edge of frame toward the wall. THE CAMERA DOES NOT MOVE when he goes.

CUT at 0:05.

=== SHOT 2 — 0:05 to 0:08 — CLOSE-UP ON PIKK'S FACE, 85mm, LOCKED — THE LINE IS CUT OFF BY THE CUT ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT:
PIKK (throwing it away, half-audible, an ordinary workplace remark filling a silence): "Honestly, this lot aren't the worst I've worked—"

Close on PIKK at the wall in three-quarter, warm amber from the slot below lighting his chin, cold doorway light on the back of his head. Below frame he is pushing his hand into the slot; we see only his face, his shoulder moving as he reaches. HIS FACE IS CASUAL AND BORED. THE SHOT ENDS WHILE HIS MOUTH IS STILL OPEN ON THE WORD "worked". The sentence is never finished — the cut takes it.

CUT at 0:08.

=== SHOT 3 — 0:08 to 0:12 — CLOSE-UP, 85mm, ABSOLUTELY LOCKED, REAL TIME — THE HAND ===
NOBODY SPEAKS IN THIS SHOT. HE MAKES NO SOUND OF PAIN, BECAUSE IT DOES NOT HURT YET.

Tight on ONE slot in the dark granite with PIKK'S HAND in it up to the wrist — compact, olive-grey, the soot-grey sleeve pushed back. HUGE AND COMPLETELY OUT OF FOCUS AT FRAME RIGHT, CLOSE TO THE LENS, is ONE of the two glass pods on its armature; the second pod sits sharp and small on the far side of the slot. A HARD WARM AMBER RAKE from inside the slot lies across the back of his hand at the start.
ACROSS THREE SECONDS, IN ONE UNBROKEN TAKE, ALL OF THIS HAPPENS AT ONCE: THE AMBER RAKE INSIDE THE SLOT DIMS SMOOTHLY DOWN AND GOES OUT, so the hand ends lit only by flat cold daylight. HIS NAIL BEDS GO WHITE FIRST, then the whiteness travels up the fingers to the second knuckle, then across the back of the hand, then to the wrist. DELICATE WHITE FROST GROWS OUTWARD FROM HIS KNUCKLES INTO THE AIR in fine needles. The two pods CLICK HARD, TWICE.
THE CAMERA DOES NOT MOVE AT ALL and THERE IS NO CUT INSIDE THIS SHOT.

CUT at 0:12.

=== SHOT 4 — 0:12 to 0:16 — MEDIUM, 40mm, HANDHELD ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT:
AMINA (fast, loud, two words, the only time she raises her voice all season): "Out. Out."
PIKK (flat, puzzled, unhurried, looking at his hand): "That's my hand."

HANDHELD, loose and alive. Never a whip pan, never a jolt. CLOSE TO THE LENS AND OUT OF FOCUS AT FRAME LEFT IS BEATRICE'S SHOULDER AND THE SIDE OF HER HEAD — we stand behind the person who did not step forward, and she does not move at all. TOMAS ENTERS AT FRAME RIGHT CLOSE TO THE LENS AND LARGE IN THE FRAME — his head, his tall cream tube collar and the looping engraved ribbon plainly visible — crossing from the cold doorway light into the warm slot light, and takes PIKK by the elbow and lifts his hand out of the wall with the unhurried competence of a man closing a drawer. PIKK'S HAND IS BLANCHED WHITE TO THE WRIST, rimed at the knuckles, frost still growing outward from it. He looks at it with mild professional annoyance, the way a man looks at something he has put down and cannot immediately find.

CUT at 0:16.

=== SHOT 5 — 0:16 to 0:30 — CLOSE-UP, 85mm, ABSOLUTELY LOCKED — THE SAME FRAME AS SHOT 3 ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT, IN THIS ORDER:
AMINA (off screen, reading her own notebook back, clipped and appalled — the unit is JOULES, a unit of energy): "Four hundred thousand joules. Three seconds. One person."
(then FOUR SECONDS IN WHICH NOBODY SPEAKS)
BEATRICE (off screen): "Why not you?"
TOMAS (off screen, a diagnosis, flat, informative, entirely without malice): "I don't like any of you."
(ONE FULL SECOND OF SILENCE)
TOMAS (off screen, a correction, because he cannot let an inaccurate impression stand): "It was not intended as a comfort."

THIS IS THE IDENTICAL CAMERA POSITION, LENS AND FRAMING AS SHOT 3: the same slot, the same out-of-focus pod huge at frame right, the same second pod sharp beyond it. The audience must recognise this frame. THE ONLY TWO DIFFERENCES ARE THE HAND AND THE LIGHT. TOMAS'S HAND — a tall man's pale hand with the black sleeve and the TURNED-BACK CREAM CUFF of his robe-coat at the wrist — goes into the SAME slot and stays there. Deep in the background, small and out of focus, PIKK holds his white hand against his chest, so both hands are in one frame.
FOR FOUR FULL SECONDS NOTHING HAPPENS, AND THE NOTHING IS THE POINT: THE AMBER LIGHT INSIDE THE SLOT STAYS FULLY LIT, STEADY AND UNCHANGED. TOMAS'S FINGERS STAY PINK AND CLEAN. THE PODS STAY STILL AND SILENT. There is no cutaway, no music and no sound cue — the audience waits for something that never arrives. Then he takes his hand out, turns it over once, looks at it, and it is completely ordinary.
THE LAST LINE, "It was not intended as a comfort.", IS THE LAST SOUND IN THE FILM. He finishes every word of it. Nothing is said after it.

SOUND: a flat continuous cold wind at the doorway, unchanged and indifferent from the first frame to the last. Pod armatures clicking. A pencil on paper. THE SLOT ITSELF MAKES NO SOUND AT ALL AT ANY POINT. The chamber has a tight dry acoustic with NO reverb tail. NO MUSIC, no score, no swells, no drone, no stingers and no sound effect on any cut. ALL BACKGROUND VOICES ARE LOW AND COMPLETELY INDISTINCT AND NO WORD IN THEM CAN BE MADE OUT; only the named lines in this film are intelligible.

Pronounce these words exactly and clearly: VOLUNTEERS, DOCTOR, HONESTLY, WORKED, JOULES, INTENDED, COMFORT.

PALETTE: slot amber #A9721F, frost white #E9F1F4, worn stone #B9B1A2, slate blue #5B6E7E, dark granite #4A4B48.

PHYSICS: cold injury behaves as real cold injury — white at the nail beds first, then progressively up toward the body, no immediate pain, no reversal. The stone is never frosted. Nothing glows anywhere except the faint warm amber inside the slots. No machinery, no gears, no runes, no magical light, no lens flare, no particles, no smoke, no digital element, no screens, no interface, no signage, no ornament, and no Victorian, Edwardian, medieval or steampunk detail.
